QUOTE: "transfer accuracy of 0.78" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: transfer_acc is 0.73; 0.78 is the strong-model ceiling (strong_acc).
QUOTE: "a clear improvement over the 0.49 baseline" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The 0.20 gain is only ~2.2 SE with no baseline error reported, so "clear" overstates the certainty.
